title: PAL extends flight suspension for Manila-Riyadh route amid Houthi attack on airport
summary: PAL has extended the suspension of its flights connecting Manila and Riyadh for another 72 hours, covering October 9 to 11, citing ongoing safety and airport condition evaluations.
